name: After recital C
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the political repression and humanitarian situation in Cuba
part_text: Cb. whereas the presence of the Cuban medical brigade in Calabria, which has provided essential health services in peripheral, rural and underserved areas of southern Italy, has been widely recognised as a positive example of international medical cooperation and has generated a deep sense of gratitude among European citizens towards Cuba for its contribution to the protection of the right to health;
